verdict.rationale: Kling documents general text/image-to-video generation with native speech co-generation and persistent character identity and voice (Elements). It never documents a script-to-presenter workflow, a stock avatar library, custom avatar creation, or lip-synced talking-head output. These are adjacent generative features rather than the avatar-presenter capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can paste a script and get a presenter-led video with a stock or custom avatar, no camera or studio
